Brokerage or data provider with which to authorize the connection. The /live/auth0/authorize API accepts requests in the following format:

AuthorizeExternalConnectionRequest Model - Request for authenticating with an external brokerage or data provider for a live algorithm.
brokerage string Enum
required
The brokerage to authenticate a connection with. Options : ['alpaca', 'tradestation', 'charlesschwab', 'tastytrade']
Example 
{
  "brokerage": "alpaca"
}
